column1: Table: Number of leaves collected per pot and per date using visible-near infrared (VNIR) hyperspectral imaging (HSI). Empty cells indicates no HSI acquitions due to sampling. 'NA' indicates missing data due to a technical malfunction.
[1] : Dates of HSI acquisitions are indicated in days post-inoculation (dpi).
[2]: The number of pot containing durum wheat (Triticum turgidum subsp durum) plants varies from 01 to 48 pots according to the date.
[3]: EPO_67 and EPO_68 refer to two durum wheat genotypes originating from the David et al. (2014) Evolutionnary Pre-breeding pOpulation (EPO).  https://doi.org/10.1007/s11032-014-0179-z.

[4]: "Infected" plants were inoculated with the Zymoseptoria tritici strain P1a dissolved in distilled water/Tween 20 mixture at a concentration of 1.106 spores/mL. “Non-infected” plants were inoculated with distilled water/Tween 20 mixture only.
[5]: The G column represents the left side of the pot, where wheat plants were cultivated under controlled conditions.
[6]: The D column represents the right side of the pot, where wheat plants were cultivated under controlled conditions.
